title: Can quirky-model truth probes detect a backdoor? Bridging ELK probing and mechanistic anomaly detection

original_idea.body:
# Bridging ELK Probing and MAD

Train truth probe on clean inputs; treat probe-output disagreement on triggered inputs as anomaly score, report ROC.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: bridges ELK and MAD into a monitoring prototype for backdoor/deception detection.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logistic-regression probe on public backdoored models; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused anomaly-detection ROC experiment; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: public models, single GPU, monitoring infra valuable.

low_compute.reasoning: Probing on small model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Both ELK probes and MAD are studied; bridging them for backdoor detection may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: ELK and MAD exist separately; the explicit bridge may be partially open.
